articles.title: 'Bada bhai will be CM': Amit Shah after BJP-SAD announce alliance in Punjab
articles.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party and Shiromani Akali Dal have announced their alliance for the upcoming 2027 assembly elections. The two parties aim to jointly contest all 117 seats with Akali Dal in the lead.

'Breaking the door down': Ex-cricketer hails Priyansh Arya after record-breaking 181
articles.summary: In a stunning display of talent, Priyansh Arya scored a record-breaking 181 runs against Tamil Nadu in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy. His incredible innings featured 19 sixes, tying the world record for T20 sixes in one match.

articles.title: An Australian woman's Doberman fell nearly six metres into an abandoned mineshaft
articles.summary: In a remarkable rescue in Western Victoria, a Doberman named Magic plummeted nearly six metres into an abandoned mineshaft while pursuing a rabbit. Thankfully, the Fire Rescue Victoria's high-angle rescue team managed to pull her out unharmed.

articles.title: LA landlord accused of fake ICE scare targeting Latino tenants, ordered to pay $7.65 million
articles.summary: Andrew and Brigid Elrod won $7.65 million after a Los Angeles jury found their Koreatown landlord, K3 Holdings, had harassed and retaliated against them for organising tenants. A former company manager testified that its principal suggested using fake ICE uniforms to frighten Latino residents into leaving.

articles.title: LeT, JeM proxies exposed, ISI eyes revival of 19 dormant terror outfits in J&K
articles.summary: Pakistan's ISI is reportedly planning to revive 19 dormant terror outfits in Jammu and Kashmir as security agencies expose links between existing proxy groups and Pakistan-based organisations Lashkar-e-Taiba and Jaish-e-Mohammed. The strategy could involve reconnecting with former militants, recruiting local youth and rebuilding networks to evade investigations.

articles.title: PSU statutory audits: ICAI and CAG discuss cybersecurity, financial reporting and audit standards
articles.summary: ICAI organised a national workshop in New Delhi to examine statutory audit quality, transparency and accountability in public sector undertakings. Around 550 participants attended the event, which included two panel discussions and two technical sessions.

articles.title: CMAT 2027 Registration Begins: Apply by December 20, exam scheduled for February 11; check direct link here
articles.summary: CMAT 2027 registration: The National Testing Agency has started CMAT 2027 registration from November 23, 2026, for admission to management programmes in the 2027-28 academic session. Candidates can apply online until December 20, while the late application window will remain open from December 22 to 25 with an additional fee of Rs 500.

articles.title: SSC CHSL City Intimation Slip 2026 released at ssc.gov.in, check exam city and download steps
articles.summary: SSC CHSL City Intimation Slip 2026: The Staff Selection Commission has released the SSC CHSL Tier 1 City Intimation Slip 2026 on its official website, ssc.gov.in. Registered candidates can log in using their registration number, password and captcha code to check their allotted examination city.

articles.title: Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026: Vacancies increased to 13,152, applications begin November 26
articles.summary: Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026: The Gujarat Police Recruitment Board has increased LRD vacancies to 12,752 and announced 241 additional PSI cadre posts, taking total recruitment vacancies to 13,152. Applications will open on November 26, 2026, at 2 PM and close on December 16 at 11:59 PM.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' box office collection day 20 (LIVE)
articles.summary: The cinematic masterpiece 'Ramayana: Part 1' by Nitesh Tiwari continues to captivate audiences over three weeks post-launch, amassing Rs 955.45 crore net in India alone. With a total domestic revenue of Rs 1,141.65 crore and Rs 91.70 crore net during Days 16 to 19, the film has claimed the fifth spot among India's all-time blockbusters.

articles.title: Fahadh Faasil's next with '96' director Prem Kumar titled 'Asareeri'
articles.summary: Fahadh Faasil is set to lead the cast in the upcoming thriller 'Asareeri,' with direction by C Prem Kumar and a planned release in 2027. The unveiling of the film's title was accompanied by an engaging promotional video that hints at a gripping storyline and Fahadh's distinctive role.

articles.title: Sharwanand says ‘Bhogi’ has reintroduced him as an actor, praises Sampath Nandi
articles.summary: Sharwanand is eagerly looking forward to the debut of his upcoming film 'Bhogi', helmed by director Sampath Nandi. Though the actor had some early concerns regarding the film's direction, he now boasts confidence in its outcome.

articles.title: 'O.M' BO Day 5 [Live]: Dhanush's film slows down on weekdays
articles.summary: Dhanush's film 'O.M: Operation Mole' opened strongly but faced a decline in box office collections during weekdays. After earning Rs 18.10 crore on its first day, the film's collections dropped significantly on Monday.
